art.subject: Hodgson's Hawk-Cuckoo (Hierococcyx nisicolor), adult (sexes alike), as a rare spring vagrant in a Korean forest in May: head, nape and upperparts dark slate-grey, the wings tinged brownish; throat whitish; breast white with variable rufous-orange streaks and smudges, in some birds almost washed rufous on the upper breast, fading to a white belly; undertail coverts white; tail grey with three or four narrow black bars, a broad black subterminal band and a rufous tip. Bright yellow eye-ring; short bill, dark with a yellowish base; legs yellow.
art.pose: perched upright on a branch inside the forest, side view
art.scene: Korean broadleaf forest on an offshore island in May, during spring migration, fresh green leaves and dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a branch: dark slate-grey head and upperparts, bright yellow eye-ring, dark bill with a yellowish base, whitish throat, white breast with rufous-orange streaks and smudges, white belly and undertail coverts, long grey tail with narrow black bars, a broad black subterminal band and a rufous tip, yellow legs

adult, side view perched with the tail hanging down: slate-grey back and brownish-grey wings, grey tail crossed by three or four narrow black bars, a broad black subterminal band and a rufous tip, white undertail coverts

juvenile, side view perched: brown upperparts barred rufous, whitish underparts with bold dark streaks edged rufous on the breast sides and neck, yellow eye-ring, barred tail with a pale tip, yellow legs
art.build: Medium-sized, slim hawk-cuckoo, a little smaller and slimmer than a Common Cuckoo and clearly smaller than the Northern Hawk-Cuckoo, shaped like a small sparrowhawk: rounded head, rather short rounded wings and a long, broad, slightly rounded tail that extends well beyond the wingtips at rest. Bill short and slightly decurved, not hooked. Legs short and yellow, with two toes forward and two back. Perches upright to slightly hunched inside the canopy.
art.basis: 형태: 국내외 종 설명 교차 확인(출처 목록) · tools/ART_RULES.md
avoid: Do not wash the whole breast and belly plain rufous-orange like Northern Hawk-Cuckoo (Hierococcyx hyperythrus); here the breast is white with rufous streaks or smudges and the belly is white.
Do not paint dark bars across the belly and flanks; the underparts are streaked, not barred (barred flanks mark Large Hawk-Cuckoo, Hierococcyx sparverioides).
Do not paint a hooked raptor bill or strong talons; it is a cuckoo with a small bill and weak feet.
Do not paint a plain tail without the broad black band and rufous tip.
